flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/Notice/hook/ActionNotice.tsx (modal konfirmasi, onComModalOk), components/modal/ModalConfirm.tsx, pages/Notice/hook/useNoticeSubmit.tsx; ocmsadminapi workflows/furnish/manualreview/controllers/ManualReviewController. Lainnya: tidak ada code terkait
note: Status: Demo paid (50% of 75%). The story asks that the OIC can confirm or cancel the send-email + reject action. A confirmation modal with OK and Cancel exists: OK runs the reject and then sends the email, Cancel closes the modal without calling any API. Not matching the story wording: the modal shows no details the OIC can judge as right or wrong, and the confirmed 'send' means immediate sending, not a schedule (see OCMS41.26). No maintenance ticket changes the verdict.
recommendation: Claim mostly: confirm and cancel work. The modal does not carry email/schedule details yet

steps.step: After submit, a confirmation dialog appears for the reject action
steps.detail: On Submit in UPDATE mode with Decision Status R, onConfirmation fills the modal with title 'Submit' and message 'Do you wish to proceed with the rejection?' (ActionNotice.tsx:187-193, 205-209). The modal is mounted at Form.tsx:101.

steps.step: OIC confirms (OK): the reject runs and the email is sent
steps.detail: OK calls onComModalOk then onSaveSubmit (ActionNotice.tsx:313-316), which calls rejectFurnish (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:198-200) and, when Send Email/SMS is ticked and compose_list has entries, composeFurnish to POST manual-review/send-email (useNoticeSubmit.tsx:215-216; ManualReviewController.java:300-301). The email goes out immediately, not scheduled; the missing schedule is judged in OCMS41.26 step 4 and OCMS41.29, not in this step.

steps.step: OIC cancels (Cancel): no reject and no email
steps.detail: Cancel calls onClose which only sets show=false (ActionNotice.tsx:386; ModalConfirm.tsx:36-43). onSaveSubmit is not called, so no call goes to manual-review/reject or send-email. The form and the send list stay intact.

steps.step: OIC can judge whether the displayed details are wrong before deciding
steps.detail: The confirmation modal is one generic sentence (ActionNotice.tsx:193), without email or schedule details. The details to judge are in the Reply tab send list with Preview and Remove (ComposeList.tsx:57-69), but they do not appear in that modal. Same fit as OCMS41.27 step 5.
